name: A Better Ingredient
label: Quest
description: A Better Ingredient: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is as I feared -- the toxin is simply too weak for such a powerful creature.

If we are to create a toxin of high enough potency, you must venture to the bottom of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, unlock the secrets of the altar and recover a putrid vine from the guardian there. The temple is dangerous, and it would behoove you to bring friends.
Return to me when this is done.

clips.title: Completion
paras: At last, the toxin can be created in full. I dare not require you to inflict it upon the creature again, as I have asked too much already.
You have my thanks and respect. May you be well in your travels, friend.
